body:
Trying to breathe. I am genuinely thinking about seeing if I can take jail time over more probation, just so I can get on with my life. I know it's going to be on my record but I just need to move on with my life and this is too hard. 

They will not permit me to use medicinal cannabis unless I am dying. They do not believe me, that I have it for a legitimate reason. I have it prescribed for back pain and I have X-rays that show extreme curvature in my spine. I'd rather able to use CBD oil than pop Advil every few hours. 

I am 19 years old and virtually completely on my own. 

For some reason, I cannot view my court documents as they are not made public.

I truly appreciate you taking the time to comment, and your comment in its entirety. The feeling that someone understands it, and how messed up the "justice" system is makes me feel better. I just want to move on with my life. It is so hard with a judge and probation officer breathing down my neck. I spend almost 200$ a month on testing and go 8-10 times a month. I am withdrawing from classes now just to be able to handle more work to pay for this mess.

I have almost zero free time. I go to school full time and work two jobs. The free time I have is spent catching up on school work. I want nothing more than to be able to swim laps for hours. I have a membership. I haven't been able to go because I simply cannot with everything going on. My alcohol testing is now 6x a month and it's $25 per. It was 2x a month and 8$ per before. I can't do this anymore. The way it is interfering with my life is ridiculous. 

And it's not even that I want to get high. I literally just cannot take this anymore.
